description: List Node.js applications running on a web hosting. Returns `site_id` + `vhost_route_id` for each app — both are needed for every other nodejs_* tool. Each Infomaniak Node.js hosting runs a single app, so this typically returns one entry. Uses the public Bearer API (more resilient than manager-private during Infomaniak maintenance).

hosting_id.description: Parent web_hosting id (service_id 1). Discover via infomaniak_list_hostings.

name: infomaniak_list_nodejs_apps

site_id.description: Pass this as `site_id` to all other nodejs_* tools — Infomaniak's manager-private nodejs routes are keyed by site_id, NOT hosting_id.
